common_abstraction: root output may vary along that kernel
additional views or structural constraints are required if the target does not factor through the projection
source_to_target_mapping: latent object -> refined global BSD data package
additional view/constraint -> all-prime, archimedean, determinant reciprocity, or complex-to-p-adic reconstruction theorem

cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Run a projection-nullspace calibration before inventing a higher-rank bridge: if the declared fixed-p output leaves a root-critical coordinate free in the formal model, demand a theorem that removes that freedom on actual elliptic curves.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Define pi_p and the refined root functional exactly; construct a formal same-projection/different-root witness or prove that the target factors through pi_p on the actual theorem image. Keep the two authority levels separate.
